svg.title: Theta Plotter Top-Down Wiring Schematic
svg.desc: Top-down style wiring schematic with peripherals drawn as modules with labeled screw terminals and point-to-point wiring. X uses a shielded cable with white B- continuing to the motor's blue lead; Y and A use stock blue B- leads.
svg.text: Theta Pen Plotter - Top-Down Wiring Schematic
Modules are drawn as top-down terminal layouts. Verify actual silkscreen order on your received hardware before applying power.

g.text: One output pair per branch; no hidden wire split
Top-down logical terminal locations; final labels must match board silkscreen.
Each RP23CNC axis has one G terminal.
That G must be jumpered to TB6600
PUL-, DIR-, and ENA- for that axis.
X shielded cable; white continues to motor blue
Use a separate top-down sheet once final
12 V fused branch -> 6 V buck -> DRV8833 VM
12 V fused branch -> 5 V buck -> Pico/SparkFun logic
HX711 should mount near load cell.
This top-down view shows terminal locations by label, not guaranteed physical order. Before wiring, compare each drawn terminal label with the silkscreen on your exact RP23CNC and TB6600 hardware.
The repeated G wires from each RP23CNC axis terminal mean that axis G must be jumpered to PUL-, DIR-, and ENA-. Use ferrules or a small terminal/jumper block; do not leave loose multi-wire strands.
Motor colors: X uses white for the shielded-cable B- conductor (to motor blue); Y/A use stock blue for B-.
